hooks.command:
PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ] && exit 0
PARENT_DIR="$(dirname "$PROJECT_DIR")"
BASENAME="$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR")"
if [ "$BASENAME" = "parent-pressure-android" ]; then
  BACKEND="$PARENT_DIR/parent-pressure-backend"
else
  BACKEND="$PROJECT_DIR"
fi
ANDROID="$PARENT_DIR/parent-pressure-android"
[ -d "$BACKEND/.git" ] || exit 0
cd "$BACKEND" || exit 0
CLAUDE_MD_COMMIT=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$CLAUDE_MD_COMMIT" ]; then
  COMMITS_SINCE=$(git rev-list --count "$CLAUDE_MD_COMMIT"..HEAD -- . ":(exclude)CLAUDE.md" 2>/dev/null)
else
  COMMITS_SINCE=0
fi
UNCOMMITTED=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
ANDROID_UNCOMMITTED=0
if [ -d "$ANDROID/.git" ]; then
  ANDROID_UNCOMMITTED=$(cd "$ANDROID" && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
fi
if [ "${UNCOMMITTED:-0}" -gt 0 ] || [ "${COMMITS_SINCE:-0}" -ge 3 ] || [ "${ANDROID_UNCOMMITTED:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"CLAUDE.md may be out of date - there are uncommitted changes or 3+ commits since it was last updated. Consider updating it (backend + android repos) before ending this session.\"}"
fi
